description: This file contains cryptographic validation functions for Diffie-Hellman parameters, including checks for public key validity and parameter safety, within the BoringSSL library.

methods.name: DH_check_pub_key
methods.description: Checks the validity of a Diffie-Hellman public key, ensuring it is within valid bounds and on the correct subgroup if q is specified.

methods.name: DH_check
methods.description: Validates the Diffie-Hellman parameters p, g, and q for safety and suitability, including prime checks and generator suitability.
